halomcc-your-journey-begins-467ebc6bb3.description: Pari iṣẹ apinfunni ipolongo kan tabi baramu ti elere pupọ.
halomcc-your-journey-begins-467ebc6bb3.guideDescription: Lati ṣii aṣeyọri “Your Journey Begins” laarin Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), o kan nilo lati pari iṣẹ-ipolongo eyikeyi ni kikun tabi ibaamu ti elere pupọ.

halomcc-just-getting-started-24ea4c9ab6.description: Pa 100 awọn ọta tabi awọn ẹrọ orin.
halomcc-just-getting-started-24ea4c9ab6.guideDescription: Lati ṣii aṣeyọri “Just Getting Started” laarin Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), o kan nilo lati pa apapọ awọn ọta 100 tabi awọn oṣere ni iṣẹ ipolongo eyikeyi tabi ibaamu pupọ.

halomcc-i-m-sorry-dave-c5354b9fe4.description: Halo: Reach: Wa ibuwọlu alakomeji ti o farapamọ.
halomcc-i-m-sorry-dave-c5354b9fe4.guideDescription:
Lati ṣii aṣeyọri “I’m Sorry, Dave” ni Halo: Reach laarin Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), o nilo lati wa ẹyin Ọjọ ajinde Kristi kan pato ti o nbọla fun David Candland, oludari UI ti ere naa. Eyi ni itọsọna alaye lori bi o ṣe le rii:

1. Bẹrẹ iṣẹ ipolongo eyikeyi tabi maapu pupọ ni Halo: Reach.
2. Gbe ohun ija ti ** ko ni ẹya-ara ti iwọn-sisun. Awọn apẹẹrẹ ti o wọpọ pẹlu Assault Rifle tabi Pistol Plasma.
3. Tẹ bọtini sisun (nigbagbogbo ọpá ti o tọ lori awọn afaworanhan tabi bọtini ti a yan lori PC) si “zoom in” pẹlu ohun ija ti ko ni iwọn.
4. Wo ni pẹkipẹki ** igun apa osi ** ti iboju rẹ. Iwọ yoo ṣe akiyesi okun koodu alakomeji ti o han ni ṣoki.
5. Koodu alakomeji yii tumọ si ọrọ naa "Dave" ni aṣoju alakomeji ASCII.

Nipa titẹle awọn igbesẹ wọnyi ati wiwo koodu alakomeji, iwọ yoo ṣii “I’m Sorry, Dave” aṣeyọri.

halomcc-balaho-s-most-wanted-03c5a591ce.guideDescription: Lati ṣii aṣeyọri “Balaho’s Most Wanted” ni Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), iwọ yoo nilo lati yọkuro apapọ apapọ 100 Grunts ni ipo PVE, eyiti o pẹlu Ipolongo, Firefight, ati Spartan Ops. O da, aṣeyọri yii le ni irọrun ṣiṣi silẹ nipasẹ ṣiṣere deede.

halomcc-where-am-i-0ea732d545.description: Pari awọn iṣẹ apinfunni 10 tabi awọn ere elere pupọ.
halomcc-where-am-i-0ea732d545.guideDescription: Lati ṣii aṣeyọri "Where Am I?" laarin Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), o kan nilo lati pari ni kikun ti awọn iṣẹ apinfunni ipolongo 10 tabi awọn ere-kere 10 ti ọpọlọpọ awọn ere.

halomcc-the-one-percent-088630ade1.guideDescription: Lati ṣii aṣeyọri “The One Percent” ni Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), iwọ yoo nilo lati yọkuro apapọ apapọ awọn Elite 100 ni ipo PVE, eyiti o pẹlu Ipolongo, Firefight, ati Spartan Ops. O da, aṣeyọri yii le ni irọrun ṣiṣi silẹ nipasẹ ṣiṣere deede.

halomcc-we-re-just-getting-started-4fd09.guideDescription: Lati ṣii aṣeyọri "We're Just Getting Started" ni Halo: Reach laarin Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), o kan nilo lati ṣere nipasẹ iṣẹ apinfunni "Winter Contingency" lati ibẹrẹ si ipari lori eyikeyi iṣoro.

halomcc-spoilsport-3dada00509.guideDescription: Lati ṣii aṣeyọri “Spoilsport” ni Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), iwọ yoo nilo lati yọkuro apapọ apapọ Jackals 100 ni ipo PVE, eyiti o pẹlu Ipolongo, Firefight, ati Spartan Ops. O da, aṣeyọri yii le ni irọrun ṣiṣi silẹ nipasẹ ṣiṣere deede.

halomcc-just-a-taste-9a52606cd4.description: Gba ipolongo 500 tabi awọn ami iyin akojọ orin.
halomcc-just-a-taste-9a52606cd4.guideDescription: Lati ṣii aṣeyọri "Just A Taste" ni Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), iwọ yoo nilo lati gba ipolongo 500 tabi awọn ami-ami orin kikọ. Awọn ami iyin wọnyi le jẹ mina lakoko ti o nṣire ipolongo tabi kopa ninu matchmaking. Lati mu ilọsiwaju rẹ pọ si, dojukọ pipa awọn ọta ni iyara ati ni imunadoko, ni ero fun pipa pupọ ati pipa awọn ami iyin spree. Ṣiṣere lori iṣoro Rọrun ni ipolongo naa ni a ṣe iṣeduro, bi o ṣe gba ọ laaye lati ṣajọpọ awọn ami iyin laisi afikun ipenija ti awọn iṣoro giga.

halomcc-protocol-dictates-action-e8ac811.description: Halo: Reach: Pari ONI: Ipilẹ idà.
halomcc-protocol-dictates-action-e8ac811.guideDescription: Lati ṣii aṣeyọri "Protocol Dictates Action" ni Halo: Reach laarin Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), o kan nilo lati ṣere nipasẹ iṣẹ apinfunni "Protocol Dictates Action" lati ibẹrẹ si ipari lori eyikeyi iṣoro.

halomcc-stick-with-it-a-little-longer-17.description: Mu elere pupọ tabi ere àjọ-op o kere ju oṣu mẹta lẹhin ere akọkọ rẹ.
halomcc-stick-with-it-a-little-longer-17.guideDescription:
Lati ṣii aṣeyọri “Stick With It...A Little Longer” ni Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), o kan nilo lati ṣe ere elere pupọ tabi ere àjọ-op o kere ju oṣu mẹta lẹhin ti o ṣe ere akọkọ rẹ.

Ko dabi awọn aṣeyọri miiran, eyi ko le ṣe ṣiṣi silẹ nipa ṣiṣafọwọyi ọjọ eto rẹ, bi o ti jẹri nipasẹ olupin naa.

halomcc-pillar-of-autumn-ca48de1ce8.description: Halo CE: Pari Origun Igba Irẹdanu Ewe.
halomcc-pillar-of-autumn-ca48de1ce8.guideDescription: Lati ṣii aṣeyọri "Pillar of Autumn" ni Halo: CE laarin Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), o kan nilo lati ṣere nipasẹ iṣẹ apinfunni "Pillar of Autumn" lati ibẹrẹ si ipari lori eyikeyi iṣoro.

halomcc-the-guardians-are-coming-f21d333.guideDescription:
Aṣeyọri “The Guardians Are Coming” ni Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC) le jẹ ṣiṣi silẹ nipa ipade ayanmọ kuku dani: pipa ni ọna ti o da ẹrọ ere naa jẹ. Nigbati eyi ba ṣẹlẹ, ere ni igbagbogbo ṣafihan ifiranṣẹ naa, "You were killed by The Guardians." Eyi ni ọna titọ lati jere aṣeyọri yii:

1. Lori akojọ aṣayan akọkọ ti Halo MCC, yan ipolongo Halo 2.
2. Lọ si apinfunni yan.
3. Ṣeto awọn scarab timole bi lọwọ.
4. Fifuye akọkọ ise tabi eyikeyi miiran ise ti o fẹ.
5. Mu ṣiṣẹ titi iwọ o fi gba ohun ija kan.
6. Iyaworan pakà.
7. Aṣeyọri ṣiṣi silẹ!

Ti o ba tẹle awọn igbesẹ wọnyi, iwọ yoo ni "The Guardians Are Coming" ninu akojọpọ rẹ.

halomcc-my-buddy-chips-b7c213043b.description: Halo CE: Ja lẹgbẹẹ Chips Dubbo ki o tẹtisi awọn ọrọ ọgbọn rẹ.
halomcc-my-buddy-chips-b7c213043b.guideDescription:
Lati gba aṣeyọri "My Buddy Chips" ni Halo: Combat Evolved laarin Halo: The Master Chief Collection, o nilo lati pade iwa Chips Dubbo lakoko ipolongo Halo: Combat Evolved. O le rii ni ọpọlọpọ awọn iṣẹ apinfunni, ṣugbọn ọpọlọpọ awọn oṣere ti ni aṣeyọri lori iṣẹ apinfunni "The Pillar of Autumn."

Jẹ ki awọn ọkọ oju omi rẹ wa laaye, paapaa lakoko apakan nibiti awọn ologun Majẹmu wọ ọkọ oju-omi rẹ, ki o tẹtisi ọrọ asọye pato Dubbo. Aṣeyọri yẹ ki o ṣii lẹhin ipade yii.

O tọ lati ṣe akiyesi pe irisi Chips Dubbo le jẹ laileto diẹ, ati pe ti o ba ni iṣoro wiwa rẹ, gbiyanju lati tun ṣe iṣẹ apinfunni naa ki o mu u lọra, ni idaniloju pe o duro pẹlu awọn ọkọ oju omi rẹ ki o tẹtisi gbogbo ijiroro wọn1.

halomcc-i-need-a-weapon-0305f283a3.guideDescription: Lati ṣii aṣeyọri "I Need A Weapon" ni Halo: Reach laarin Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), o kan nilo lati ṣere nipasẹ iṣẹ apinfunni "Nightfall" lati ibẹrẹ si ipari lori eyikeyi iṣoro.

halomcc-bite-the-hand-cc4675d512.description: Pa 343 Olùgbéejáde ni matchmaking tabi ẹnikan ti o ni yi aseyori.
halomcc-bite-the-hand-cc4675d512.guideDescription: Lati ṣii "Bite The Hand" ni Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), isinyi fun ibaramu pupọ ati pa awọn alatako lakoko awọn ere deede. Ibi-afẹde le jẹ olupilẹṣẹ tabi ẹrọ orin eyikeyi ti o ti ni aṣeyọri yii tẹlẹ, nitorinaa tẹsiwaju ṣiṣere titi iwọ o fi gba pipa iyege. Fidio naa fihan ẹya atilẹba Halo 4 ti aṣeyọri, eyiti o nlo okunfa ibaramu kanna.

halomcc-mind-the-skill-gap-566b495f16.description: Halo: Reach: Ṣakiyesi aami ti ile-iṣẹ iwakusa ti o ni botini.
halomcc-mind-the-skill-gap-566b495f16.guideDescription: Lati ṣii "Mind the Skill Gap" ni Halo: Reach laarin Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), lori Italologo Ọkọ, wa aami BXR Mining ni ile-iṣẹ iwakusa. Duro ni ibiti o ti ni wiwo ti o ye ki o wo taara ni ami ile-iṣẹ lati ṣe okunfa aṣeyọri naa.

halomcc-all-out-of-bubblegum-22bdb2c4d2.guideDescription: Lati ṣii aṣeyọri "All Out of Bubblegum" ni Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), iwọ yoo nilo lati gba ipolongo 1000 tabi awọn ami-ami orin kikọ. Lati mu ilọsiwaju rẹ pọ si, dojukọ pipa awọn ọta ni iyara ati ni imunadoko, ni ero fun pipa pupọ ati pipa awọn ami iyin spree. Ṣiṣere lori iṣoro Rọrun ni ipolongo naa ni a ṣe iṣeduro, bi o ṣe gba ọ laaye lati ṣajọpọ awọn ami iyin laisi afikun ipenija ti awọn iṣoro giga.

halomcc-to-war-5b5e005c5c.description: Halo: Reach: Pari Italolobo ti Ọkọ.
halomcc-to-war-5b5e005c5c.guideDescription: Lati ṣii aṣeyọri "To War" ni Halo: Reach laarin Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), o kan nilo lati ṣere nipasẹ iṣẹ apinfunni "Tip of the Spear" lati ibẹrẹ si ipari lori eyikeyi iṣoro.

halomcc-halo-6ecaacfb1e.guideDescription: Lati ṣii aṣeyọri "Halo" ni Halo: Combat Evolved laarin Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), o kan nilo lati ṣere nipasẹ iṣẹ apinfunni "Halo" lati ibẹrẹ si ipari lori eyikeyi iṣoro.

halomcc-standard-operating-brocedure-ffb.description: Pari ipele àjọ-op eyikeyi lori iṣoro deede.
halomcc-standard-operating-brocedure-ffb.guideDescription:
Lati ṣii aṣeyọri “Standard Operating Brocedure” laarin Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), o kan nilo lati pari ipele àjọ-op eyikeyi lori iṣoro deede.

O tun le gba aṣeyọri "Standard Operating Brocedure" nipa ti ndun lori Akikanju tabi iṣoro arosọ.

halomcc-going-bananas-a3478a4999.guideDescription: Lati ṣii "Going Bananas" ni Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), imukuro 100 Brutes. Tun ṣe alabapade Halo 3 tabi Halo 3: ODST ti o ṣe afihan ọta yii. Jeki imukuro awọn ọta ti o ni ẹtọ bi o ṣe n ṣiṣẹ nipasẹ awọn aṣeyọri miiran.

halomcc-you-flew-pretty-good-ef665babe8.description: Halo: Reach: Pari Oru gigun ti Solace.
halomcc-you-flew-pretty-good-ef665babe8.guideDescription: Lati ṣii aṣeyọri "You Flew Pretty Good" ni Halo: Reach laarin Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), o kan nilo lati ṣere nipasẹ iṣẹ apinfunni "Long Night of Solace" lati ibẹrẹ si ipari lori eyikeyi iṣoro.

halomcc-truth-and-reconciliation-3d669bd.description: Halo CE: Pari Otitọ ati Ilaja.
halomcc-truth-and-reconciliation-3d669bd.guideDescription: Lati ṣii aṣeyọri "Truth and Reconciliation" ni Halo: Combat Evolved laarin Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), o kan nilo lati ṣere nipasẹ iṣẹ apinfunni "Truth and Reconciliation" lati ibẹrẹ si ipari lori eyikeyi iṣoro.

halomcc-delicious-brains-a0b4eb557d.guideDescription: Lati ṣii "Delicious Brains" ni Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), imukuro 100 Ikun-omi. Tun iṣẹ ipolongo Ikun-eru kan ṣe bii Ile-ikawe naa. Jeki imukuro awọn ọta ti o ni ẹtọ bi o ṣe n ṣiṣẹ nipasẹ awọn aṣeyọri miiran.

halomcc-into-the-howling-dark-faf89601ca.guideDescription: Lati ṣii aṣeyọri "Into The Howling Dark" ni Halo: Reach laarin Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), o kan nilo lati ṣere nipasẹ iṣẹ apinfunni "Exodus" lati ibẹrẹ si ipari lori eyikeyi iṣoro.

halomcc-gruntageddon-bbcb54f8fb.guideDescription: Lati ṣii "Gruntageddon" ni Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), imukuro 1000 Grunts. Tun iṣẹ ipolongo Majẹmu-eru kan ṣiṣẹ nibiti ọta yoo han ni awọn ẹgbẹ. Jeki imukuro awọn ọta ti o ni ẹtọ bi o ṣe n ṣiṣẹ nipasẹ awọn aṣeyọri miiran.

halomcc-front-page-news-951f11d7eb.description: Halo: Reach: Wa mi ninu ọgba.
halomcc-front-page-news-951f11d7eb.guideDescription: Lati ṣii "Front Page News" ni Halo: Reach laarin Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), wa mi ninu ọgba. Lo fidio naa lati ṣe idanimọ ami-ilẹ ati isunmọ. Ti o ba jẹ ohun kan, gbe sunmọ to lati ṣe ajọṣepọ pẹlu rẹ ṣaaju tẹsiwaju nipasẹ agbegbe naa.

halomcc-dust-and-echoes-abf0cf7266.guideDescription: Lati ṣii “Dust And Echoes” ni Halo: Reach laarin Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), gbe Aleksandria Tuntun lati ibẹrẹ lori eyikeyi iṣoro ki o mu ṣiṣẹ de ibi-afẹde ikẹhin. Tẹle awọn asami apinfunni ki o pari ipele naa ki a gbasilẹ ohun ti o han gbangba ni Yan Iṣẹ.

halomcc-the-silent-cartographer-463f102f.description: Halo CE: Pari Aworan aworan ipalọlọ naa.
halomcc-the-silent-cartographer-463f102f.guideDescription: Lati ṣii “The Silent Cartographer” ni Halo: Combat Evolved Anniversary laarin Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), gbe Cartographer Silent lati ibẹrẹ lori eyikeyi iṣoro ki o ṣiṣẹ titi de ibi-afẹde ikẹhin. De ibudo aabo ni akọkọ lati ṣii ohun elo naa, lẹhinna sọkalẹ lọ si Oluyaworan.

halomcc-what-about-bob-d728d4e4c1.description: Halo: Reach: Wa ati imukuro ọkan ninu awọn Elite Alakoso Ranger ti o farapamọ.
halomcc-what-about-bob-d728d4e4c1.guideDescription: Lati ṣii "What About Bob?" ni Halo: Reach laarin Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), wa ati yọkuro ọkan ninu awọn Elite Ranger Ranger ti o farapamọ. Lo fidio naa lati ṣe idanimọ ami-ilẹ ati isunmọ. Ti o ba jẹ ohun kan, gbe sunmọ to lati ṣe ajọṣepọ pẹlu rẹ ṣaaju tẹsiwaju nipasẹ agbegbe naa.

halomcc-easy-to-overlook-7e6f804af3.description: Halo: Reach: Wọle si ibaraẹnisọrọ redio UNSC ti o farapamọ.
halomcc-easy-to-overlook-7e6f804af3.guideDescription: Lati ṣii "Easy to Overlook" ni Halo: Reach laarin Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), wọle si olubasọrọ redio UNSC ti o farapamọ. Bẹrẹ lati ipo ti o han ninu fidio ki o tẹle iṣeto rẹ ṣaaju igbiyanju iṣẹ naa.

halomcc-your-heresy-will-stay-your-feet-.description: Halo: Reach: Pa Gbajumo Zealot ṣaaju ki o to le salọ lakoko Italologo Ọkọ.
halomcc-your-heresy-will-stay-your-feet-.guideDescription: Lati ṣii "Your Heresy Will Stay Your Feet" ni Halo: Reach laarin Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), pa Gbajumo Zealot ṣaaju ki o to le salọ lakoko Italologo Ọkọ naa. Lo ohun ija kanna, ọkọ, tabi ipo ti o han ninu fidio. Ti ibi-afẹde naa ba nilo fifun ipari kan pato, dawọ ṣiṣe ibaje miiran ni kete ti ibi-afẹde ba jẹ alailagbara.

halomcc-the-chips-dubbo-46489745e0.description: Halo 2: Ja lẹgbẹẹ arosọ Chips Dubbo ki o tẹtisi awọn ọrọ rẹ.
halomcc-the-chips-dubbo-46489745e0.guideDescription: Lati ṣii “THE Chips Dubbo?” ni Halo 2: Anniversary laarin Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), mu Outskirts ki o duro si nitosi awọn Marines lakoko ti o ja nipasẹ awọn alabapade ṣiṣi. Jeki Marine ti n sọ Ọstrelia laaye ki o si sunmọ titi iwọ o fi gbọ Chips Dubbo sọrọ. Ti o ba ku ṣaaju ki o to gbọ ọ, tun bẹrẹ lati aaye ayẹwo ṣiṣi.
